name: Princess Elisabeth of Bohemia
shortBio: Philosopher and sovereign princess of Herford, whose acute philosophical correspondence with René Descartes formulated the decisive mind-body interaction critique of Cartesian dualism.
centralQuestion: How can the human soul, being an immaterial thinking substance, determine the movements of the bodily spirits to perform voluntary actions?

keyWorks.title: Correspondence with René Descartes (1643–1649)
keyWorks.description: Celebrated dialectical exchange confronting Cartesian metaphysics with the physical problem of mental causation and moral psychology.
